overview_description.description:
Spendesk is designed to save time and money across the entire spending process with 100% visibility and built-in automation. Ultimately, businesses that use Spendesk empower finance teams to gain valuable time to invest in strategic topics to grow the business. 
Founded in 2016, Spendesk is now trusted by thousands of businesses from start-ups to established brands, such as Algolia, Soundcloud, Curve, Doctolib, Gousto, Raisin, Sezane, Wefox. 
Spendesk-backed CFO Connect is the fastest-growing global community of finance leaders with more than 7,000 members.

about_short_description.short_description: Spendesk is a smart spend management software designed for both finance teams and employees.

product.name: Spendesk Spend Management Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that centralizes corporate cards, expenses, invoices, procurement, budgets, approvals, reporting, and accounting workflows for finance teams.

product.name: Spendesk Corporate Cards
product.description: Physical and virtual Visa debit cards for business spending, with configurable budgets, merchant restrictions, approval rules, and real-time transaction visibility.

product.name: Spendesk Expense Management
product.description: Digital expense claims and reimbursement software that captures receipts, routes approvals, tracks claims, and exports expense data to accounting systems.

product.name: Spendesk Accounts Payable
product.description: Accounts payable software for capturing, approving, paying, and reconciling supplier invoices within a centralized spend management workflow.

product.name: Spendesk Procure-to-Pay
product.description: A procure-to-pay workflow connecting purchase requests, approvals, budgets, supplier payments, and accounting records in one system.

product.name: Spendesk Budget Management
product.description: Budgeting and spend-control capabilities for setting financial limits, assigning ownership, enforcing policies, and monitoring company spending in real time.
